info.title: Vendors
info.description: API endpoints used to manage vendors in WinTeam.

get.description: This API endpoint will return the creation of Vendors and their related contacts.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Format - int32. The size of the page.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Format - int32. The page number you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: searchFieldName
parameters.description: A datapoint you’d like to search records by. Possible values are: "VendorNumber", "VendorTypeId", "VendorName", "VendorStatus", "Phone", "AccountNumber", "ParentVendorNumber", "Address1", "Address2", "City", "State", "Zip" .

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: The text you’ll search for in results from the "SearchFieldName" you’ve specified.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: A datapoint you’d like to sort records by. Possible values are:  "VendorNumber", "VendorTypeId", "VendorName", "VendorStatus", "Phone", "AccountNumber", "ParentVendorNumber", "Address1", "Address2", "City", "State", "Zip" .

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the order should be ascending (true) or descending (false)
